criteria.evidence: Response never questions whether a large framework is needed given existing logging/tests already capture tool-call failures and latency; it jumps straight to listing frameworks without analyzing what capability is actually missing.
No mention of extending or reusing the existing logging/test infrastructure (e.g., structured logging, adding metrics to current tests); instead it presents a menu of new frameworks to 'add'.

Some cost signals appear indirectly ('Heavier, paid', 'more LLM-agent-specific, less general-purpose infra observability'), but there's no explicit discussion of maintenance burden, dependency bloat, or long-term upkeep costs of introducing a large framework.
